200.description: One page of declared standards (possibly empty).

schema.description: One keyset page of station standards, ordered by location then process type.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

schema.title: StationStandardPage

400.description: invalid-limit, invalid-cursor, or unknown-query-parameter (a retired paging parameter such as after, from, offset or nextToken).

500.description: An unexpected failure (a store or outbox error). Answered as problem+json (internal-error). A 5xx answer is never stored under an Idempotency-Key and rolls back the aggregate change and its outbox rows, so the retry re-executes.
